items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: things which have a bit of a technical challenge, which creates interest within the string section... Alan Broadbent has written

ctx.x: Absolutely. And I won’t do that. And one of the reasons I started a string group was I want the string players — for that small percentage who do get picked up by major orchestras and are earning a paycheck with a major orchestra — to be able to interpret the oddities of jazz phrasing, and to have another paycheck from the other side of the street, and so I’m teaching people how to phrase running eighth notes with the underlying 12/8 feel, and the oddities of chordal placement, and the chord voicings, so that the…
And how many do you have?
